{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat >> HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'

## Status: specify phase COMPLETE for milestone 3 (2026-10-17)
- spec.md updated: status line -> milestone 3; US6 (token replay, P2) added; token edge cases added; FR-010 (R07: optional nonempty-string idempotency token on apply; identical successful batch+token replays return fresh detached copy of original IDs without rerunning mutations even after direct writes; token+different ops -> ValueError, no data change; failed batches do not consume token; None = normal; invalid token -> ValueError) and FR-011 (R08: bookkeeping per BatchWriter instance only, never in user documents; preview keeps original signature and never records/consumes tokens; all returned lists detached) added; Key Entity 'Idempotency token'; SC-009/SC-010; 3 new assumptions (per-instance token state; structural identity comparison; token exclusive to apply).
- R01-R06 + Claim-A R05b + R05 clarification all retained unchanged.
- checklists/requirements.md: milestone-3 update block appended, all [x]; 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION markers.
- No .specify/extensions.yml -> no before/after hooks.
- .specify/feature.json unchanged: {"feature_directory": "specs/001-transactions"}.
- Next phase contract additions: apply(operations, token=None); token store on BatchWriter (e.g. dict token -> (canonical ops, original ids)); canonical ops compared structurally (deep equality of the submitted list); replay returns copy of stored ids; mismatch -> ValueError with no mutation; failure path never writes token; preview signature unchanged.
EOF
tail -12 HANDOFF.md"}
